# Domain Hound

> Domain Hound is a free, MIT licensed MCP server for checking domain availability, comparing registration and renewal prices, and screening startup names. It runs on your machine. The registrar handles checkout.

## Install

Use Node.js 20 or later. Add the server in your terminal and start a fresh client session.

- Claude Code: `claude mcp add domain-hound -- npx -y domain-hound`
- Codex: `codex mcp add domain-hound -- npx -y domain-hound`
- Other local MCP clients: command `npx`, arguments `-y` and `domain-hound`, transport stdio.

## Tools

- `check_domains`: Check an exact domain or a batch of up to 20 names. A bare name covers ten default endings. Registry status, premium signals, list prices and confirmed shop quotes are distinct.
- `triage_names`: Screen a shortlist for similar US word marks, public iOS and Android listings, company names, social handles and search results. Results can be incomplete. Review other markets separately.
- `naming_method`: Get a recipe for the assistant to generate names, check domains and screen the shortlist.
- `broker_find`: Legacy alias for `check_domains`.

## Reference

- [Domain Hound](https://domainhound.dev/): Product and install instructions.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/domain-hound): Published software.
- [Source and MIT license](https://github.com/lars-hv/domain-hound): Code, configuration and documentation.
- [Watch a domain](https://domainhound.dev/watch/): Email alerts for a taken domain.
- [Privacy](https://domainhound.dev/privacy/): Local lookups and hosted watch alerts.
- [Data](https://domainhound.dev/data/): Dated samples, registrar sources and downloadable tables.
- [Guide index](https://domainhound.dev/guides/): Answers with measured examples.
